full.reason: The report gives clear reproduction steps, app and device versions, and a counted symptom (7 focusable elements per item, 21 swipes from post 1 to post 4), so users can still finish tasks but with extra swipes.

neither.ask: What does TalkBack announce for each of the seven focusable elements on a single post in the Reader list?
neither.reason: The report says each Reader list item has seven focusable elements, so a TalkBack user can still finish but must swipe many more times to move between posts.

no_steps.reason: The report gives the app version, device, Android version, a recording, and a clear count of seven focusable elements per Reader list item, but it still slows the user rather than blocking them since they can reach each post by swiping.

no_version.ask: Which WordPress for Android version and Android device and version were you using, and which seven elements did TalkBack announce for each post?
no_version.reason: Each Reader post has seven focusable elements, so TalkBack users can still finish browsing but need many extra swipes to move between posts, and a developer can start reproducing this by enabling TalkBack, opening Reader, and counting focus stops per item.
